title: Verse
description: Adds a bunch of Weapons, Ores, Dimensions, and More to Minecraft.
body:
Adds a bunch of Weapons, Ores, Dimensions, and More to Minecraft.


# Note the Description is still being worked on

## New Food
- Coal Apples
- Copper Apples
- Iron Apples
- Redstone Apples
- Lapis Apples
- Emerald Apples 
- Diamond Apples

## New Weapons
- Knives
- Boardswords

## New Ores
Overworld:
- Boskalt
- Quartz
- Amber
- Garnet
- Sapphire

End:
- Dragonrite

## Tier 1:
Materials:
- Iron
- Boskalt

## Tier 2:
Materials:
- Diamond
- Garnet
- Sapphire

## Tier 3:
Materials:
- Netherite
- Emerite

## Tier 4:
Materials:
- Dragonrite
- Sculk Steel



## The Miners Dream:
Contains all ores in the game and other useful things for other things in the mod, created with reinforced stone and a flint and boskalt

Biomes:
- Dirty Caves
- Limestone Caves
- Marble Caves
- Mystical Caves
